Keys: registrationId keeps every saga message for one registration on one partition,
in order. sessionId on the seat topics co-partitions them with session-capacity-changed
for the M3 fill-rate join. ticketCode keys the ticket topics.
No consumer on main reads seats-reserved, seats-released, registration-cancelled,
registration-expired or ticket-issued yet: analytics (M3) and waitlist promotion
